subject: Post-demo: procurement & approval path — next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia@acme.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 07 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: procurement & approval path — next steps

Hi Sofia / Tom —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps while it’s fresh: 

Summary from today
- Demo: walked through live inference latency/cost dashboard, dedicated capacity options, and the rollout path (canary -> full).
- Procurement signal: Tom mentioned finance would prefer PO for committed capacity; card OK for pilot under $5k.
- Compliance: Sofia requested our standard procurement questionnaire + draft SOW.

What I’ll do
- Send over the questionnaire + SOW draft (attached).
- Share HubSpot deal link and a short mutual action plan (MAP) template.

What we need from you
- Confirm whether the initial pilot will be on card or a PO (Tom you suggested card for POC).
- Who is the budget owner/economic buyer we should include? You mentioned likely the AI Platform lead or Finance — who specifically signs off on committed spend?
- Any preferred internal procurement timelines (SLA vs legal redlines)?

Proposed next steps
1) Sofia/Tom: Confirm pilot payment method and budget owner by EOD Tue (10 Mar).
2) Marissa: Follow up with SOW and questionnaire (attached) — target Mon 9 Mar.
3) If PO path, loop in Aditya (legal) for contract routing and redline expectations.

Attachments: Acme_SOW_draft.pdf, Procurement_Questionnaire.xlsx

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if helpful.

Best,
Marissa
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0183

From: Tom Reed <tom.reed@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sofia Alvarez <sofia@acme.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Sat, 07 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: procurement & approval path — next steps

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. A few quick answers: 

- Pilot payment: We’ll run a 6-week pilot on corporate card (limit ~$4k) to validate latency/cost at our typical workload. If results look good, we’ll move to a PO for reserved/dedicated capacity.
- Budget owner: Economic owner for this initiative is Sofia Alvarez (CC’d) — she owns the budget for AI Platform experiments.
- Signatory path for PO: Legal + Procurement + CFO sign-off for any committed spend > $50k; for reserved capacity we’ll need a PO and an authorized signatory (usually our Head of Finance).
- Timeline: If pilot succeeds, procurement indicated a ~3-week paper process for standard SOW + PO routing.

Happy to connect next week if you want to align on SOW redlines.

- Tom
Head of Platform Engineering | Acme Corp
Tom.Reed@acme.com

---
From: Sofia Alvarez <sofia@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@acme.com>
Date: Sat, 07 Mar 2026 12:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: procurement & approval path — next steps

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the recap and the docs. Confirming a couple things from my side: 

- I am the budget owner for the pilot and will champion the business case. I’ll own sign-off on the pilot spend (card) and coordinate with Finance for any PO conversion.
- For the PO path, procurement will require a signed SOW + our standard PO form filled. We’ll also need standard security/processing info (SOC2, data handling) — Tom, procurement will reach out with the questionnaire; Marissa, looks like you attached it already which is great.
- Internal approvers: I’ll loop Finance (CFO team) if the committed spend goes above our small projects threshold; final signatory is usually our VP Finance for multi-quarter commitments.

Next step from me: I’ll confirm the card details for the pilot by Monday and introduce the procurement contact (procurement@acme.com) into the thread if they need anything further.

Sofia Alvarez
Director, AI Platform | Acme Corp
sofia@acme.com

Looping you all in following confirmation from Acme — they will run a card pilot (~$4k) and Sofia is the economic buyer. If pilot scales, they will move to a PO and expect ~3-week turnaround for SOW+PO routing.

Action items for Redwood team:
- Aditya: be prepared for contract redlines around liability and data processing. I’ve attached the SOW draft they received.
- Vivek: heads-up that this is a likely reserved capacity opportunity if pilot performance and TCO checks out.
- Rachel/CS: be ready to run a 6-week onboarding/support plan and set success metrics (latency targets, cost per 1M tokens).

I’ll follow up with an updated MAP in HubSpot and ping procurement contacts when Sofia introduces them.

Thanks — M.
